notes.title: Upgrades and content enhancements
notes.content:
[h2][b]ImmersiX Explorers and VR enthusiasts![/b][/h2]

We've been listening closely and thanks to your amazing detailed Steam reviews, we’ve rolled out a series of upgrades and content enhancements to make your experience smoother, richer, and more immersive than ever.

Since the beginning of this year we have made several positive changes to the including:

[list]
[*] Improved performance & responsiveness across devices
[*] Enhanced visuals and smoother transitions inside experiences
[*] Better navigation and interaction cues for easier story flow[/list]
Fresh updates to Sharkarma and Weightless that makes your experience underwater and in space even more immersive and real 

Your voice continues to shape ImmersiX. Every review, comment, and suggestion helps us evolve, so keep them coming and step into your favourite immersive stories and live within!

notes.title: Weightless & Sharkarma: Part 1 Now Available on ImmersiX!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/48be49abd83760f0872fe9ff8da4bc5ebd5f75b7.png[/img]


[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

We’re excited to launch two immersive 6DoF experiences today on the ImmersiX App!

"[b]Weightless[/b]", a fully free VR experience that lets you drift through space in complete zero gravity. Move freely with six degrees of freedom, feel the vastness of space, and lose yourself in a stunningly immersive environment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771490/ImmersiX__Weightless_by_Arilena_Ara/

"[b]Sharkarma: Guardian of the Oceans (Part 1)[/b]", a cinematic VR movie that puts you at the center of an underwater survival thriller. A deep-sea expedition takes a deadly turn, and you’re caught in the middle. 

Now available in Early Access for $3.99, buy now and get Part 2 for free upon release in 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771480/ImmersiX__Sharkarma/

Explore more on ImmersiX – all available for free:
[list]
[*] "[b]Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ[/b]". Discover the revolutionary 6DoF volumetric video format behind our experiences. This guided intro will show you what makes PresenZ different - and why it’s the future of immersive content.
[*] "[b]Construct VR[/b]". Originally released in 2021, this stylized short drops you into a robotic world full of atmosphere and visual flair—a glimpse into the origins of our 6DoF storytelling.
[/list]

[b]Finally, we also updated the ImmersiX Player![/b]

To make your experience smoother, we've improved the ImmersiX Player with:
[list]
[*] Optimized file format for faster pre-loading, reducing wait times.
[*] Anonymous analytics to gather feedback on playback quality and enhance future performance.
[/list]
Explore, experience, and immerse yourself today!

[b]Useful Links:[/b]
ImmersiX Manual: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix

Contact Us: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix/contact-us

Privacy Policy: https://docs.v-nova.com/immersix/privacy-policy


[b]V-Nova Studios[/b]

notes.title: Patch notes / App updates 2025.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/2312cdc6b303ecd3369453ac60b0f97779f2b1af.png[/img]

[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Thank you all for testing out ImmersiX and for giving us your feedback so far!

Some of you may have noticed that we have continuously been improving certain aspects within our app – here’s a quick breakdown of the latest update!

1. We have made some improvements to our player, in an effort to maximise the frame compression and amplify the quality of our existing content.

2. We have improved most of the background images in “Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ”, which include:
    Brand new images.
    Upscaled and updated existing images.

3. We have re-compressed some of the scenes in “Introduction to V-Nova PresenZ” to maximise their quality.

4. Due to the MetaQuest update causing an error with the colours within the app, we have improved our XR swapchain format selection to combat the issue.

Thank you for the support so far! We’re working hard to get some new content out for you guys soon. 

- V-Nova Studios

notes.title: Welcome to Sharkarma: The Movie, Part 1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/b5bf47d0589a62f0b9ee4ee7c2181e1dd5a9c486.png[/img]

Hello everyone! :)

Welcome to Sharkarma: The Movie, Part 1, the first part of our DLC 2-part volumetric short movie that will soon be available on our volumetric movie app, ImmersiX!

Sharkarma is a thrilling story of love, friendship, and sharks (of course). Having had the chance to interview several Environmental Activists on the topic of shark finning, we felt compelled to join the discussion by creating this movie as a commentary on this rising issue. 

Thank you for taking the time to read this, and we hope you will enjoy 'Sharkarma Part 1' as much as we enjoyed making it. :)

See you in the new year!

- V-Nova Studios

notes.title: Welcome to Weightless!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/d661bad0fc9293cc456f3e382f6631ec8b882d3e.png[/img]

Hello everyone! :)

Welcome to Weightless, our DLC volumetric music experience that will soon be available on our volumetric movie app, ImmersiX!

Weightless is our first dive into the music industry, and a challenge we posed to ourselves to see how we could bring the art of storytelling together with technical complexity in 6DoF VR. We were honoured to have worked with Grammy-Award winner Diane Warren, as well as international pop sensation Arilena Ara, to open this new chapter in fan experiences.

Thank you for taking the time to read this, and we hope you will enjoy 'Weightless' as much as we enjoyed making it. :)

See you in the new year!

- V-Nova Studios

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771490/Weightless_by_Arilena_Ara/

notes.title: Welcome to ImmersiX!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/aa2742222d436584ebb47abd3df2a0401e7b416c.png[/img]

Welcome to our page! Thank you for being here.

ImmersiX is an app designed for you to enjoy all of the exciting VR content we have planned in one place... but to make sure it is working at its best, we need your help! 

This is why, in this Early Access period, we ask you to share your thoughts with us – whatever they may be! Start discussions, leave reviews, or contact us directly! Any feedback is appreciated, and will be useful to us as we work to develop our app alongside you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329603/22a9b69800d4aab9bda0a6cdb4f4ad6a663ace17.gif[/img]

Once again, thank you for being here, and we hope you enjoy exploring this part of ImmersiX’ journey with us. Please wishlist us below to keep up to date on all things ImmersiX soon too! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704450/ImmersiX/

- V-Nova Studios’
